title: Richard Feynman - The.Character.of.Physical.Law - Part 2 (full version)
summary: Part 2 of Richard Feynman's Messenger Lectures at Cornell, The Character of Physical Law, on the relation of mathematics to physics. He explains why understanding nature requires mathematics.
why: Recommended as a lecture so clear that no formal training is needed to follow it, and cited on why math is needed for physics.

quote.text: Feynman is so good at explaining these concepts that you don't even need any formal training to understand them.
